title: Carrots
description: Carrots are root vegetables that require loose, well-drained soil. They are harvested for their edible roots.

category.name: Root Vegetables
category.description: Plants that primarily grow underground and are harvested for their roots. They often require loose, well-drained soil.

title: Spinach
description: Spinach is a leafy green vegetable that needs consistent moisture and grows best in cool weather.

category.name: Leafy Greens
category.description: Vegetables grown for their edible leaves. These plants usually need consistent moisture and are often sensitive to heat.

title: Tomatoes
description: Tomatoes are fruit vegetables that thrive in sunlight and require regular watering to produce healthy fruits.

category.name: Fruit Vegetables
category.description: These plants produce fruits that are consumed as vegetables. They typically need plenty of sunlight and regular watering.

title: Peas
description: Peas are legumes that improve soil fertility by fixing nitrogen. They are often grown in rotation with other crops.

category.name: Legumes
category.description: Plants that fix nitrogen in the soil, improving fertility. They are often grown in rotation with other crops to maintain soil health.

title: Basil
description: Basil is a popular herb used in cooking for its aromatic leaves. It can be grown in containers or in the ground.

category.name: Herbs
category.description: Plants grown for their aromatic leaves and are often used in cooking and medicinal purposes. They can be grown in containers or in-ground.

title: Marigolds
description: Marigolds are flowers that attract beneficial insects and can also help repel pests from the garden.

category.name: Flowers
category.description: Plants grown primarily for their ornamental flowers. They can attract pollinators and beneficial insects or repel pests.

title: Cucumbers
description: Cucumbers are vines that require support to grow vertically. They are ideal for maximizing space in small gardens.

category.name: Vines and Climbers
category.description: Plants that require support to grow vertically. They are ideal for maximizing space in small gardens by growing upward.

title: Cabbage
description: Cabbage is a brassica vegetable that grows best in cool weather and may require protection from pests like aphids.

category.name: Brassicas
category.description: Cool-season vegetables that are members of the cabbage family. They can be susceptible to pests like aphids and cabbage worms.

title: Potatoes
description: Potatoes are tubers that grow underground. They require well-drained soil and proper timing for optimal growth.

category.name: Bulbs and Tubers
category.description: Underground storage organs. They often require well-drained soil and are planted at specific times of the year for optimal growth.

title: Asparagus
description: Asparagus is a perennial vegetable that grows back every year, providing a continuous harvest.

category.name: Perennials
category.description: Plants that grow back every year without needing to be replanted. They are great for low-maintenance gardening and providing continuous harvests.

title: Lavender
description: Lavender is an aromatic herb known for its soothing scent and medicinal uses.

category.name: Medicinals and Aromatics
category.description: Plants that have medicinal properties or aromatic uses. They are often grown in separate beds or containers due to their specific needs and uses.

title: Clover
description: Clover is a cover crop used to improve soil health, suppress weeds, and prevent erosion in gardens.

category.name: Cover Crops
category.description: Plants grown to cover the soil rather than for harvest. They help improve soil health, suppress weeds, and prevent erosion.

title: Borage
description: Borage is a companion plant known for attracting pollinators and improving the health of nearby plants.

category.name: Companion Plants
category.description: Plants grown together to benefit each other, either by deterring pests, attracting beneficial insects, or enhancing growth.

title: Hostas
description: Hostas are shade-tolerant plants that thrive in areas with limited sunlight, making them perfect for shaded gardens.

category.name: Shade-Tolerant Plants
category.description: Plants that can thrive in shaded or partially shaded areas of the garden. They are ideal for spaces that do not receive full sun.

title: Bee Balm
description: Bee Balm is a pollinator attractor that draws in bees and butterflies, enhancing pollination in the garden.

category.name: Pollinator Attractors
category.description: Plants specifically chosen to attract pollinators like bees, butterflies, and hummingbirds, enhancing the garden’s ecological balance.

title: Blueberries
description: Blueberries are berry bushes that produce small, delicious fruits and often require acidic soil.

category.name: Berry Bushes
category.description: Small fruit-bearing plants that produce berries. They often require acidic soil and consistent watering.
